events.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update
events.summary: We are really excited to announce that Early Access is on the way! The game will release on Steam on November 11th and continue development alongside our community. This demo will be participating to the Steam Next Fest, starting October 19th.The demo is really close to the quality you can expect from the Early Access Release, but it represents a smaller part of the content. events.title: Demo Summer Update
events.summary: We're happy to update the Near Mint demo to show what we've been working on for the last few months.Great progress has been made on a third biome, with dangerous foes and a terrifying boss, and new cards for other heroes. These will be part of the game's release, so we won't take too much time on it here.Your feedback has been of great help — we gathered it on the official Discord, on the Steam forums, and through DMs and forms from playtesters. events.title: Near Mint demo is out!
events.summary: We revealed the game a week ago, and released a demo soon after. All the team is really happy about the game reception, and we are hyped to work on new content for the full release.This week, Steam is organizing the Deckbuilders festival, and we are part of it.
